title: Library seed table
brief:
You volunteer with a neighborhood seed swap and want to reserve a table at the public library’s spring open house. Write an email to the library’s events coordinator. The swap needs one six-foot table for two volunteers from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. on April 18. You will bring labeled seed packets and take home any leftovers. Ask whether the library can provide two chairs and whether volunteers should arrive before the doors open at 11. Keep the request easy to answer.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

3e46cb9f442a048e.text:
Subject: Table request for the April 18 spring open house

Dear Events Coordinator,

Could you reserve one six-foot table for the neighborhood seed swap at the library’s spring open house on April 18? Two volunteers will staff the table from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. We’ll bring labeled seed packets and take home any leftovers.

Could the library also provide two chairs? Please let us know whether we should arrive before the doors open at 11 a.m. and, if so, what time you’d like us there.

Thank you for considering our request.
